final: WITH race_totals AS (SELECT races.name AS race_name, SUM(results.points) AS total_points, AVG(results.laps) AS average_laps FROM results JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId GROUP BY races.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points FROM race_totals) SELECT SUM(race_totals.total_points), AVG(race_totals.average_laps), AVG(race_totals.total_points - overall.average_points) FROM race_totals CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.average_points IS NOT NULL AND race_totals.total_points > overall.average_points
